programs.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programs.desc: Mike and Elvis want to debunk the idea that people should discount motors with massive miles. The team repairs a Jaguar S-Type with 195,000 miles and then puts it up against another model with just a tenth of the miles.

programs.title: Ancient Aliens
programs.desc: Researchers study giant ancient drawings found etched into the desert floor, which may be a part of an ancient alien code.

programs.title: The Proof Is Out There
programs.sub_title: Marfa Lights, Devil Goat and Subway Survivor
programs.desc: Are the famous glowing lights seen above Marfa, Texas a natural or supernatural phenomenon? What spirit possessed a goat to walk down a street like a human? Are mysterious stone carvings in Japan connected to a legendary close encounter?

programs.title: Expedition X
programs.desc: Horrified locals in Iowa are reporting sightings of a giant winged creature - the same mysterious beast that terrorized the town of Van Meter 100 years ago.

programs.title: Alien Highway
programs.desc: A recent UFO sighting in Phoenix leads Chuck and the team to Sedona, AZ. They explore whether the area's energy vortexes act as portals for otherworldly visitors.

programs.title: Expedition Unknown
programs.desc: Chasing history's biggest prize - the lost tomb and treasure of Alexander the Great - Josh dives Egypt's coast and tunnels under modern Alexandria.
